The context passages contain conflicting information regarding the age at which Tenzin Gyatso was enthroned. Most sources state he was enthroned on February 22, 1940, at the age of 2 or 4 (e.g., "recognized at the age of two," "at the age of four"). Only one passage claims he was enthroned at age 15 in 1950 and another fragmentary sentence mentions "age" near 1950, but none support the premise that he was 5 years old in 1940. In 1940, he was 2 years old (born 1938).

However, the question asks to complete the phrase: "In 1940, at age 5, Tenzin Gyatso was enthroned as the 14th one of these spiritual leaders [?]". Based on the context provided, the blank is asking for the title he held. The context repeatedly identifies him as the **14th Dalai Lama**. The specific age "5" in the question appears to be an error in the premise (he was 2 in 1940), but the title remains consistent across all documents.

The phrase "one of these spiritual leaders" likely refers to the title itself. The most fitting completion for "14th one of these spiritual leaders" is **Dalai Lama**.

<answer>Dalai Lama</answer>
